text_block_list.text:
The day of the Fan Appreciation Festival 
has arrived.

It's an event packed with fans, much like 
a school festival, but—

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
You're Silence Suzuka-san, right?! The 
recent Kinko Sho was so moving~!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Ah, thank you very much...

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
You're participating in today's Red & 
White Relay too, right! I'm really looking 
forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yes, um... Thank you very much.

For someone who struggles with crowds and 
conversation, this space seemed a bit 
uncomfortable for her...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...To be honest, when fans call out to 
me...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I'm at a loss for how to reply.

...That said, many fans were captivated by 
her at the recent Kinko Sho—

As I walked around the academy, I found 
myself surrounded in no time.

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Seeing you run always gives me courage!

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text: Which race are you entering next!?

text_block_list.name: Fan D
text_block_list.text:
Is it true that you like strawberry 
daifuku!?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Um, well... Mmmgh...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"...Excuse me, it's about time for me to 
warm up for the relay. If you'll excuse 
me...!"

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: ...So cool...!

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Still, that's exactly what's so great 
about them!

text_block_list.name: Fan D
text_block_list.text:
Totally~! She's so stoic about racing and 
never plays up to anyone—she's so cool~!

Yet her modest response seemed to capture 
the fans' hearts in its own way...!

Soon after, the Red and White Relay kicked 
off! It's a headline event featuring 
popular Umamusume gathered from all across 
the academy.

Serving as commentator was the 
combat-sports-loving Umamusume, El Condor 
Pasa!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
A monumental showdown bound to be a 
scorcher! Who will emerge victorious in 
the battle of the century?!
(UOOOOOOOOHHH--!!)

"The race turned into a white-hot, 
neck-and-neck contest— and soon the baton 
was passed to the anchors, Air Groove and 
Silence Suzuka!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove-senpai from the Red Team 
receives the baton! And she dashes off 
like the wind~!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
However, at this moment, White Team's 
Fuji-senpai passes the baton to 
Suzuka-senpai...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
It's an anchor leg showdown between the 
"Out of this World Escape Artist" Silence 
Suzuka and the "Empress" Air Groove!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Can the Red Team hold the lead!? Can the 
White Team catch up and overtake them!?

The venue's excitement reached a fever 
pitch—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
—Air Groove holds on to the lead and 
crosses the line! The winner goes to the 
Red Team!
(UWAAAHH-!)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Phew...
choice_data_list: Good work! That was so close.
Good work! That was so close!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Trainer. Yes... we were so close.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Even though she had a late start, Air 
Groove's final stretch kick... Her 
sharpness really is incredible.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: If possible, I wanted to take the lead.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yes... And, I feel a little bad about 
it...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"Um... There were fans who came especially 
looking forward to that relay, after all."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Why do you have such a surprised look 
on your face?
choice_data_list: No... we'll definitely win next time!
No... We'll definitely win next time!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yes. Next time, for sure.

Her experience at the Fan Appreciation 
Festival seemed to have sparked something 
in Silence Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
—The White Team is slightly faster, could 
it be?! The baton was passed by the 
narrowest of margins!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The "Out of this World Escape Artist" 
Silence Suzuka and the "Empress" Air 
Groove! What a fiery anchor clash this 
isssss!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Run, Silence Suzuka—! You can do it—!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Hang in there, you can do it!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
(...Such passionate, roaring cheers... It 
feels just like running on an actual 
racetrack.)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: (I want to... go beyond this heat!)

The venue's excitement reached a fever 
pitch—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
—Silence Suzuka holds her lead all the way 
to the finish! The victory goes to the 
White Team—!
(UWAAAHH-!)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Fufu, thank you very much, Trainer.
choice_data_list: The whole venue was absolutely buzzing!

The whole venue was absolutely buzzing, 
wasn't it!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yes, it was almost like a racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Sound... air... vibration...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Beyond that heat, the quiet air felt so 
comfortable...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I wish I had expressed my gratitude to the 
fans a bit more properly.
choice_data_list: Just let your racing do the talking.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: In a race...?
choice_data_list: Because I'm cheering on the way you run.
Because I'm cheering you on as you run.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Fufu, that was it. In that case...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I'll keep giving it my all, just like I 
always have.

Her experience at the Fan Appreciation 
Festival seemed to have sparked something 
in Silence Suzuka.
